summary: Shagun Sinha works in Indology and computational linguistics. She earned her PhD at Jawaharlal Nehru University, where she studied under doctoral supervisor Girish Nath Jha alongside numerous other teachers.

Shailendra Bhandare specializes in history, archaeology, and Indology. He has held positions at the British Museum as curator, the Fitzwilliam Museum on a fellowship, and the University of Oxford, including Assistant Keeper at the Ashmolean Museum and Fellow of St Cross College.
Shailja Singh completed an MBBS at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Aligarh (2019–2025). Her work includes Indology, and she is attested as concurrent faculty at Jawaharlal Nehru University in 2026.

Shaman Hatley is an Indologist and religious studies scholar. After Goddard College, he earned his PhD at the University of Pennsylvania (~2000–2007) under Harunaga Isaacson. He taught at Concordia University (~2007–2015) and joined the University of Massachusetts Boston in 2015.
Shan Shan Zhao is a Buddhist studies scholar. She completed her Master of Arts at McMaster University under the supervision of James A. Benn, also studying with Shayne Clarke and Mark Rowe.

Shanshan Jia is a scholar of Indology and Tibetology. She studied for her doctorate in Indology under Harunaga Isaacson at the University of Hamburg, where she is also attested as a project researcher in 2026.
Shantanu Nevrekar works in Indology and anthropology. He was a PhD candidate in anthropology at Stanford University (2019–2026) and served as visiting faculty at Ashoka University in 2026.
Shanti Bhikshu Shastri (1912–2003) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied under Friedrich Weller, taught Wilhelm Rau, and served as research staff at Visva-Bharati University.
Shantu Barua specializes in Buddhist studies. He studied at Ryukoku University (attested 2015) and served as an associate professor at the University of Dhaka in 2020.

Shaoyong Ye is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar. He completed doctoral studies under Qing Duan at Peking University by 2009, later serving there as associate professor (attested 2010–2016) and faculty member (attested 2026).
Sharad Deshpande works in philosophy and Indology. He earned a degree at Savitribai Phule Pune University in 1972 and later served as a professor there, attested in 2026.
Sharon J. Roe works in religious studies and philosophy. She earned her PhD at the California Institute of Integral Studies (attested 2014) under the supervision of Steven D. Goodman.

Sharon Salzberg is a Buddhist and religious studies figure who studied at the University at Buffalo (1969) and with teachers including Satya Narayan Goenka. She co-founded the Insight Meditation Society (1974) and Barre Center for Buddhist Studies (1989).

Shashibhusan Dasgupta (1911–1964) was an Indian scholar of philosophy, Indology, and religious studies. Educated at Brojomohun College, Scottish Church College, and the University of Calcutta (MA, PhD), he served as a lecturer at the University of Calcutta (~1939–1964).

Shayne Clarke is an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MA at the University of Canterbury and a PhD at UCLA (2006). He has served as associate professor at McMaster University and research fellow at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies.

Shechen Gyaltsab (1871–1926) was a Tibetan Buddhist scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under masters including Patrul Rinpoche and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and taught figures such as Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
Shechen Rabjam Rinpoche is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure. He studied under spiritual teacher Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and founded Karuna-Shechen in 2000.

Sheila Jasanoff was educated at Radcliffe College, the University of Bonn, Harvard University, and Harvard Law School. She held faculty appointments at Cornell University (~1978–1998) and Harvard University (~1998–present).

Shek-Wing Tam (1935–2024) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied under Dudjom Rinpoche. He founded the Sino-Tibetan Buddhist Studies Association in North America, served as professor at Renmin University, and was on an advisory board at Tsinghua University.

Sheldon Pollock is an Indologist and linguist who studied under Daniel H. H. Ingalls at Harvard. He held professorships at the University of Iowa, the University of Chicago, and Columbia University, where he became Professor Emeritus in ~2021.
